Sub 'PrintData'

For each trnscardapiogrupo order carGruDescricao when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruDescricao) when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carGruCodigo when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruCodigo) when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carGruCozinhaCentral when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruCozinhaCentral) when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True order carGruStatus when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False order (carGruStatus) when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
using trnscardapiogrupoWWDS(&DynamicFiltersSelector1, &DynamicFiltersOperator1, &carGruCodigo1, &carGruDescricao1, &carDapDescricao1, &carGruCozinhaCentral1 , &carGruStatus1, &DynamicFiltersEnabled2, &DynamicFiltersSelector2, &DynamicFiltersOperator2, &carGruCodigo2, &carGruDescricao2 , &carDapDescricao2, &carGruCozinhaCentral2, &carGruStatus2, &DynamicFiltersEnabled3, &DynamicFiltersSelector3, &DynamicFiltersOperator3 , &carGruCodigo3, &carGruDescricao3, &carDapDescricao3, &carGruCozinhaCentral3, &carGruStatus3, &TFcarGruCodigo , &TFcarGruCodigo_To, &TFcarGruDescricao, &TFcarGruDescricao_Sel, &TFcarGruCozinhaCentral_Sels, &TFcarGruStatus_Sels) Where prefCodigo = &prefCodigo &carGruCozinhaCentralDescription = '' Do Case Case carGruCozinhaCentral.ToString().Trim() = !"N" &carGruCozinhaCentralDescription = "Não"
Case carGruCozinhaCentral.ToString().Trim() = !"S" &carGruCozinhaCentralDescription = "Sim"
EndCase &carGruStatusDescription = '' Do Case Case carGruStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"A" &carGruStatusDescription = "Ativo"
Case carGruStatus.ToString().Trim() = !"I" &carGruStatusDescription = "Inativo"
EndCase
Do 'BeforePrintLine' print printBlockLines_data Do 'AfterPrintLine' EndFor
